newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the panhandle area late Monday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested at the close.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 500 head slaughter steers; 21,400 head confirmed for week to date which includes 20,800 head formulated and 100 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed: 500 Week Ago: None Year Ago: None
Wk to date: 21,400 Week Ago: 29,300 Year Ago: 1,400
